miniProject.title: Prefill and decode baseline measurement harness
miniProject.brief: Extend `servelab` with phase-separated timing, synchronized device measurement and a sweep harness that keeps raw traces for a model that fits your GPU. Predict bottlenecks before profiling and defend goodput under explicit targets, so later changes have an honest baseline.
steps: Instrument per-request spans for tokenize, queue, prefill, first token, decode steps, sampling and streaming in `harness/` with a flame graph of the hottest host frame, checked against vLLM interval definitions with traces kept in `reports/`.

Derive decode-step shapes and prefill versus decode work, place both on a roofline for your GPU, and predict interference from an unchunked long prefill, checked with the TensorTonic decode problem and the Hands-On companion batching notebook with plots kept in `reports/`.

Time device work with stream-ordered events after warmup and capture, fix identical prompts, limits, stop behavior and cache state, and gate every comparison on greedy identity plus distributional agreement checked against the pinned sampling API with contracts kept in `reports/`.

Build the sweep harness in `harness/` with a single-request cell, concurrency and rate ladders and a shape matrix using `vllm bench serve` and `vllm bench latency`, retaining raw arrival and per-token records with aligned memory, utilization and power and the meter boundary in `reports/`.

Repeat key cells with interleaved trials reporting uncertainty, cross-check with a second tool, and measure observer cost with profiling on and off, keeping raw samples and overhead notes in `reports/`.

Write a dated bottleneck prediction before profiling, explain TTFT and every decode gap from synchronized ranges and scheduler state (`vllm:kv_cache_usage_perc` and `vllm:num_requests_waiting`, not memory used), report goodput under stated targets and preserve one failed prediction in `reports/`.
deliverables: Phase-separated harness in `harness/` with spans, sweeps and raw per-request records.
Device-timed baseline with warm-state rules, output contracts and uncertainty plus observer checks.
Dated predictions, residual attributions, goodput report and one preserved failure with trace queries.

checks.name: TensorTonic Decode Attention with KV Cache
checks.note: Solve by hand first, then pass the public cases in your harness.

checks.name: Hands-On LLM Serving companion batching notebook
checks.note: Reproduce batched against single timing, then add your own per-request spans.

rubric.pass: Spans split queueing from execution for a slow request against vLLM intervals with flame-graph evidence.
rubric.strong: Every decode gap maps to scheduler or execution evidence and the hottest host frame is named.

rubric.pass: Single-request, ladder and matrix cells rerun under identical contracts with raw records and uncertainty.
rubric.strong: A second tool agrees within uncertainty and observer cost is measured and kept out of the reported medians.

rubric.pass: Dated predictions precede profiles, residuals cite evidence, goodput states targets and one failure remains.
rubric.strong: The failed prediction names the disproving observation and revises the regime boundary.

miniProject.feedsInto: Sweep harness, raw traces and residual method feed KV, scheduling and kernel projects and the capstone evaluation.
